lessons.about: One noun, one verb, the present. The verb's ending already says who acts (3.4.69), so the kartā is left with the bare प्रथमा (2.3.46).

lessons.title: The object
lessons.about: What the doer most wants to reach is the karman (1.4.49); it takes द्वितीया (2.3.2) — only because the verb has not already expressed it (2.3.1 अनभिहिते).
